passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: It gives my mind a new idea.
phrases.ko: 독서는 내 마음에 새로운 생각을 줘요.

phrases.en: I sit in a quiet place.
Books are good friends, and I like reading.
phrases.ko: 책은 좋은 친구이고, 나는 독서를 좋아해요.

phrases.en: An idea from a book can stay all day.
phrases.ko: 책에서 온 생각은 하루 종일 남을 수 있어요.

phrases.en: A new word makes the next book easier.
phrases.ko: 새 단어는 다음 책을 더 쉽게 해요.

phrases.en: I imagine the place, and then I want to go.
phrases.ko: 나는 그 장소를 상상하고, 그다음에 가 보고 싶어요.

phrases.en: Quiet reading helps me grow into a kinder friend.
phrases.ko: 조용한 독서는 내가 더 친절한 친구로 자라도록 도와줘요.

full_passage_spoken: Reading is important. It gives my mind a new idea. I learn a new word. I imagine a new place. Reading helps me grow. I sit in a quiet place. Books are good friends, and I like reading. An idea from a book can stay all day. A new word makes the next book easier. I imagine the place, and then I want to go. Quiet reading helps me grow into a kinder friend.
